verses.text: Ayik ayek' winh t'a yol sk'o'ol nok' chay chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová sDiosal. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Mamin Jehová, a wal t'a skal in yahelal ix in awaj t'ayach. Ix ach tak'wi t'ayin ayik ayinek' t'a chamel. Hata' ix in awaj t'ayach, ix ab'an tas ix wala'.
Hato t'a sjulal yich ha' mar ix in a yumkanemi, junelnhej ix yoy sb'a ha ha' t'ayin. Ha ha' niwak ha' ix laj ek' t'a wib'anh.
Hata' ix in na' to ix in ik'kanel t'a ichanh t'a junelnhej, a walani to manhxa b'ak'inh ol wil a templo to ik yaji.
Ix in mukchajkanem t'a sjulal yich ha' mar chi'. Ix och b'ak'an juntzanh anh anh k'ultak ay t'a yol ha' chi' t'a in jolom.
Ix in emkan t'a yichtak juntzanh witz t'a yol ha' chi'. Junelnhej ix in kan ta' walani, palta a ach tik Jehová in Diosal ach, ix in a kolkanel t'a chamel.
Haxo yik wanxo slajwi in k 'inal ix wab'i, ix ach in na'ankot Mamin. Ix k'och in lesal t'a ichanh t'a a templo.
Ha heb' slaj yak'em sb'a t'a yechel komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, spatikejkanel a wach'k'olal heb' tza nib'ej tzak' t'a heb'.
Palta a inxo tik, ol wak' in silab' t'ayach yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ayach. Ol in k'anab'ajej b'aj ix wak' in ti' t'ayach. Ha achxonhej syal a kolwaj Mamin Jehová, xchi winhaj Jonás chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo Jehová ix chekanb'at nok' niwan chay chi', yik b'at xejajkanel winhaj Jonás chi' yuj nok' t'a sti' ha' mar chi'.
